envs.name: FEAT_URL
envs.description: feat host base URL — enables remote resolution of not-vendored features (the only row the CONSUMER side of the loader needs)

envs.name: FEAT_<ID>_SLOT
envs.description: toggle for feature <id>: which slot fills (route = built-in; other names = host anchors via feat.slot('<name>')); absent = feature dormant

envs.name: FEAT_<ID>_VERSION
envs.description: pin feature <id> to 'vN' or 'latest' (default latest; v4 only; v3 ignores this row)

envs.name: FEAT_<ID>_MOUNT
envs.description: route-slot path override; 'true' = the feature's defaultMount

envs.name: FEAT_<ID>_<SETTING>
envs.description: extra feature settings, passed through verbatim (lowercased key)
